title: SortPlan
description: Pure-data result of [`sort_path`]. Always carries both the `original` and the `sorted` vector, so consumers (human view / JSON) can present a self-contained before / after without re-running the algorithm.

EntryMove.description: One entry's movement from old to new index. Only emitted when the entry actually moved; entries that stayed in place do not generate a `EntryMove`.

reason.description: Why the entry moved — names a command for which this entry is now preferred over the one it overtook. Free-form, single short sentence; meant for the human view.

SortNote.description: Non-blocking observation about a `[[expect]]` rule. The current PATH cannot satisfy `prefer` (no PATH entry matches any preferred source), so `sort` cannot fix it by reordering — the user has to install the missing tool or adjust the rule. Surfaced so the human view can include it as an "fyi" line below the diff.

oneOf.description: `prefer` is non-empty but no PATH entry currently matches any of the listed sources, so reordering cannot fix this rule.
